title: 第23章 借你肉身一用第24章 夺舍
slug: 苟在仙宗打铁悄悄修成道祖
lines: 【你对《烈风刀》投入10000点天地精粹进行推演修行】
【累计消耗102点天地精粹，你引气入刀，对刀法真意有了初步的理解，烈风刀蜕变为《断风刀》，你初步领悟疾风刀意。】
【累计消耗698点天地精粹，你的疾风刀意已达圆满之境，你对刀法有了更深一步的理解，发现了势的存在，断风刀蜕变为《追风逐月刀》】
【累计消耗1875点天地精粹，你的刀意与刀势交融，你发现了罡意的存在，可以罡意隔空伤人斩魂，追风逐月刀蜕变为《裂空斩月刀》】
【累计消耗4896点天地精粹，你领悟本源刀意，可借万物为刀，你以刀入道，人刀合一，裂空斩月刀蜕变为《惊天拔刀斩》。】
【累计消耗9872点天地精粹，你刀道大成，领悟杀字真义，你发生顿悟，魂刀归一，惊天拔刀斩蜕变为《寂灭轮回刀》，此刀可斩身，断魂，破运，镇魔，刀意可撼法则仙威】
【累计消耗10000点天地精粹，你试图融天地法则入刀，奈何悟性平平，并无所得】
这一次，感受到脑海中大量关于刀的理解疯狂灌注，李牧火竟觉身体内似有无数细密刀刃在流淌。
好在，这些“刀刃”并未流出体外，而是不断蜕变。
很快，各种刀意凭空在脑海中演化，似能斩天斩地，无物不斩。
李牧火在这种刀意幻像中，陷入沉眠。
次日醒来，李牧火只觉眼前万物都变得活了起来。
他好奇心作祟，只是目光一扫，落在自己桌上摆放着的一块精铁上。
下一刻，虚空中竟生出数道虚无刀意，自那精铁上掠过。
“咔，咔咔~”
只一瞬间，那块精铁竟碎裂成数十块，再观其切割处，平滑如镜，似乎没耗费吹灰之力。
“这么厉害吗？”
李牧火被吓了一跳，自己仅仅是隔空看了眼那块精铁而已，那对面若是人呢？
元丹境圆满可以这么厉害吗？
李牧火从未和同境强者交手过，所以对具体的元丹境根本没个概念，只是知道自己挺强的。
所以，到底是寂灭轮回刀本身厉害，还是因为有元丹境的修为加持才厉害，他也不清楚。
但他隐隐觉得，这寂灭轮回刀，似乎超过了元丹境所能发挥出来的极限力量了。
当然，这只是他的感觉，尚且无从印证。
早上。
膳房。
钱朵朵一边吃一边说道：“昨天不知为何，无论我如何静心修行，都没法进入状态。总觉得身上麻麻的，偶尔还会像被针刺了一般。你们说，我是不是遇到瓶颈了？”
这两年下来，钱朵朵的境界提升确实不小，从一开始的练气四层，直接来到了练气六层。只要再跨出一步，便可踏足练气后期。
至于陈功，则是先钱朵朵半年，晋升练气七层，达到了练气后期。
然而，钱朵朵话音刚落，陈功便讶异道：“我昨晚修炼时的感觉和你一样，无论如何都进入不了状态，最后直接睡了，依旧觉得身上有些刺扎感。”
李牧火心头一动，连忙撇清关系道：“我昨晚没修炼，但我也有这种感觉。”
content_en:
[You invest 10,000 points of the essence of heaven and earth into "Fire Wind Knife" for deduction and practice]
[A total of 102 points of heaven and earth essence are consumed. You draw Qi into the sword and have a preliminary understanding of the true meaning of the sword technique. The Gale Wind Sword transforms into the "Broken Wind Sword" and you initially understand the meaning of the Gale Wind Sword. 】
[A total of 698 points of heaven and earth essence have been consumed. Your blast sword intention has reached perfection. You have a deeper understanding of the sword technique and discovered the existence of potential. The wind-breaking sword transformed into the "wind chasing moon sword"]
[A total of 1875 points of heaven and earth essence have been consumed. Your sword intention merges with the power of the sword. You have discovered the existence of Gang Yi. You can use Gang Yi to injure people and kill souls through the air. The Chasing Wind and Moon Sword transforms into "The Sky-Splitting Moon Sword"]
[A total of 4896 points of heaven and earth essence have been consumed. You understand the original intention of the sword and can use all things as a sword. You enter the Tao with the sword, the human sword becomes one, and the Sky-Splitting Moon Sword transforms into the "Shocking Drawing Sword". 】
[A total of 9872 points of the essence of heaven and earth have been consumed. You have become a master of swordsmanship. You have understood the true meaning of killing. You have an epiphany, and the soul knife has returned to unity. The shocking sword has transformed into the "Nirvana Reincarnation Knife". This knife can cut the body, cut off the soul, break luck, suppress demons, and the sword's will can shake the power of the law]
[A total of 10,000 points of heaven and earth essence have been consumed. You tried to integrate the laws of heaven and earth into the sword, but your understanding is mediocre and you gained nothing]
This time, Li Muhuo felt that a large amount of understanding about the knife was pouring into his mind, and Li Muhuo felt that there seemed to be countless fine blades flowing in his body.
Fortunately, these "blade" did not flow out of the body, but continued to transform.
Soon, all kinds of sword intentions evolved in his mind out of thin air, seemingly capable of cutting the sky and the earth, cutting everything.
Li Muhuo fell into a deep sleep in this illusion of sword intent.
When he woke up the next day, Li Muhuo felt that everything in front of him had become alive.
Out of curiosity, he just glanced and landed on a piece of fine iron placed on his table.
The next moment, several void sword intentions appeared in the void, passing over the fine iron.
"Ka, ka ka~"
In just an instant, the piece of fine iron broke into dozens of pieces. Looking at the cutting place again, it was as smooth as a mirror, and it seemed that no effort was expended.
"Is it so powerful?"
Li Muhuo was startled. He just glanced at the fine iron from the air. What if there was a person on the other side?
Can the Yuan Dan Realm be so powerful?
Li Muhuo had never fought against someone strong in the same realm, so he had no idea about the specific Yuan Dan realm. He just knew that he was quite strong.
Therefore, he didn't know whether it was the Nirvana Samsara Sword itself that was so powerful, or whether it was because of the blessing of the Yuan Dan Realm's cultivation.
But he vaguely felt that this Nirvana Samsara Sword seemed to have exceeded the ultimate power that the Yuan Dan realm could exert.
Of course, this is just his feeling and there is no way to confirm it.
……
Morning.
Dining room.
Qian Duoduo said while eating: "I don't know why yesterday, no matter how much I practiced meditation, I couldn't get into the state. I always felt numb on my body, and occasionally it felt like being pricked by needles. Do you think I have encountered a bottleneck?"
In the past two years, Qian Duoduo's level has indeed improved a lot. From the fourth level of Qi training at the beginning, he went directly to the sixth level of Qi training. As long as you take one more step, you can enter the later stage of Qi training.
As for Chen Gong, he started Qian Duoduo for half a year and was promoted to the seventh level of Qi training, reaching the late stage of Qi training.
However, as soon as Qian Duoduo finished speaking, Chen Gong said in surprise: "I felt the same as you when I was practicing last night. I couldn't get into the state no matter what, and finally fell asleep directly. I still felt a tingling sensation in my body."
Li Muhuo's heart moved, and he quickly cleared the air and said, "I didn't practice last night, but I also feel this way."
